pull_requests.title: Add support observer mapping
pull_requests.head: feature/support-observer-role
pull_requests.author: mei
pull_requests.body:
## Summary

The new SAML group mapping gives support staff the narrow observer role needed for the incident dashboard without granting configuration writes.

## Changes

- Maps the `support` group to `support-observer` in `src/auth/saml/group-role-mapping.ts`.

## Notes

The role is read-only and tests cover the existing engineering and viewer mappings. Checks green.

comments.author: priya
comments.body: The tests read clearly and checks are green.
